page.overview:
Who is Miles Malone?

Miles "Meattruck" Malone is a character in Cars.

"For more than sixty years, Miles Malone was known around Ornament Valley as the rain-sleet-or-shine delivery truck. If you needed something shipped fast, Miles was the one to call."
